verdict.rationale: Vanta's docs say its official Auditor API SDKs are generated from an OpenAPI specification, so a machine-readable spec exists, and the developer hub serves machine-readable docs via llms.txt and .md pages. However, no evidence shows the spec is published for download, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented, publicly downloadable OpenAPI file URL, spec coverage beyond the Auditor API (e.g. Manage Vanta API), and hands-on confirmation of retrieval.
